<h1 id="2d/b/solution">Solution</h1>

↑ **Parent:** [B](../b.md)

**True.** If $G/Z(G)$ is generated by $gZ(G)$, write $x=g^az_1$, $y=g^bz_2$ with central $z_i$; then $xy=yx$.
